passwords.note: A dictionary word with a lone digit tacked on the end is a pattern people reuse constantly.
Six repeated sixes is the first pattern anyone tries when asked for a number that feels edgy but easy to type.
Plain dictionary food words like "chicken" sit at the top of every list people pick from when they want something easy to remember.
Plain dictionary noun, the kind of word people pick because it sounds official and simple to type.
Swapping the "a" for "@" in a name is a tweak many people try, so it shows up often but not in the most common lists.
